title: A Busy Morning
text:
Anna wakes up early. She washes her face and brushes her teeth. She drinks a glass of water. Then she gets dressed quickly.

At seven thirty, Anna walks to the bus stop. She waits for the bus with her friend Ben. They talk about the football game. Then they climb onto the bus and sit at the back.

questions.text: What does Anna drink in the morning?
Who waits for the bus with Anna?
Why does Anna get dressed quickly?
options: She wants to catch the bus.
She likes to wear many clothes.
She has no clothes to wear.

questions.text: What kind of person is Ben?

vocabulary.definition: cleans something with water and soap
takes liquid into the mouth and swallows it
moves up onto something, using hands and feet

paragraph_translations: Anna budzi się wcześnie. Myje twarz i myje zęby. Pije szklankę wody. Potem szybko się ubiera.
O siódmej trzydzieści Anna idzie na przystanek autobusowy. Czeka na autobus ze swoim przyjacielem Benem. Rozmawiają o meczu piłki nożnej. Potem wchodzą do autobusu i siadają z tyłu.
